validation.measured_by: src/nba/fit_win_probability.py against the margin curve src/nba/plays.py reduces from the ESPN play-by-play; reproducible with `python -m src.nba.plays && python -m src.nba.fit_win_probability`
validation.note: points_per_elo is NOT fitted here: it is read from config/nba_model.json, because it is the Elo model’s own answer to what a rating point is worth. sigma is the spread of the regulation margin about that call; overtime_home_win is counted, not fitted; tie_half_width is solved so the model’s tip-off tie mass matches how often NBA games really end regulation level. Only time_exponent is searched, and it is searched on real in-game states rather than assumed to be the random walk’s 0.5. Regulation is 2880 seconds here, not football’s 3600. The held-out numbers are what that run reported; pregame_brier is the same model with the clock stopped at tip-off, which is the number a scoreboard shows today.
